native_mechanisms: Hang the two symbol strings on crossed rows of posts so their crossings form a lattice of DP cells, each cell's value chosen by the two symbols meeting there.
Fold the lattice along its slanting middle so all cells with equal row+column sum form one crease (anti-diagonal), processed as a unit.
Read the three stacked layers (two previous creases) at once for each crease, keep only the two most recent, and discard the spent oldest layer instead of storing the sheet.
core_technique: Anti-diagonal (wavefront) Needleman-Wunsch with three rolling diagonal buffers, one sequence pre-reversed, AVX2-vectorized across each anti-diagonal in int32 or saturating int16 lanes, computed in a min-cost gauge E=(i+j)-2H and converted back at the end.
